searchText: Is there a problem if authcall targets a precompile somehow? I would just state in authcall: targeting a precompile address gets you an exit right away either it's not particularly useful or it's a security risk down the road or for enterprise. also, precompiles are part of gas costs for berlin to see if the account is warm the spec says: ``` if addr not in accessed_addresses: dynamic_gas += 2500 # cold_account_access - warm_storage_read ``` in besu for calls today `boolean accountIsWarm = frame.warmUpAddress(to) || isPrecompile(to)` i'm not sure i understand the issue with `accessed_addresses`? so either precompiles are part of `accessed_addresses` and are always warm, like for normal calls, or they should be considered not possible to call. Just seeking extra clarity precompiles are part of `accessed_addresses` per EIP-2929 - we use the same terminology gotcha ok np so 1. precompiles are fair game to target with authcall if that ever is possible and 2. they go by same rules as EIP-2929 to be considered warm. Thank you for clarifying. yes exactly 👍 am I right to read here that the gas cost changes are: ```dynamic_gas += 6700 # NB: Not 9000, like in `CALL` ``` And the 64th check? Sorry, I'll go read the geth impl in a sec as well. yep - i forget why we used 6700 i think <@!415548822983278593> was the proponent for that the 64th check is already done so just change that constant to keep it a bit cheaper prob to go well with the auth opcode cost so it's roughly the same as a call the one really weird thing about 3074 gas calc is that if `all_but_one_64th < gas` then it throws instead of just sending `all_but_one_64th` ah I look forward to testing this 😓 any reference tests for this quite yet? I can also sync to your chain, but that's not exactly the greatest way to debug. ok lunch. unfortunately no 😦 I guess I can build one I can test the happy path puxi back online (chain nuked though, msg me for eth): https://puxi.quilt.link/ Does puxi have authcalls in its blocks? (prob not heh)

excerpts.author: atoulme
excerpts.content:
Is there a problem if authcall targets a precompile somehow?
I would just state in authcall: targeting a precompile address gets you an exit right away
either it's not particularly useful or it's a security risk down the road or for enterprise.

excerpts.author: atoulme
excerpts.content:
also, precompiles are part of gas costs for berlin to see if the account is warm
the spec says:
```
if addr not in accessed_addresses:
    dynamic_gas += 2500         # cold_account_access - warm_storage_read
```
in besu for calls today
`boolean accountIsWarm = frame.warmUpAddress(to) || isPrecompile(to)`

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: i'm not sure i understand the issue with `accessed_addresses`?

excerpts.content: so either precompiles are part of `accessed_addresses` and are always warm, like for normal calls, or they should be considered not possible to call.
